title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.33.4 finishes bounding activation time concurrency, extending the 1.33.3 fix so no remaining startup scan can slow down large projects.

highlights.title: Bounded activation concurrency
highlights.description: Closes the last unbounded activation scan so large projects stay protected from startup slowdowns and file handle exhaustion.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Bounded the concurrency of all remaining activation scans, not just R-index reads, using a shared batching helper. This closes the last gap that could still slow startup or exhaust file handles on large projects. Applies to both desktop VS Code and VS Code for the Web.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes to extension behavior in this release.
